description: Portfolio risk computation: per-holding and portfolio volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, VaR/CVaR, correlation and concentration analysis; optional predefined-scenario stress tests and Monte Carlo distribution. Bars are fetched per symbol unless you supply closes/bars per holding. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

holdings.description: 2–20 holdings, each with dollarValue or weight

date.description: Bar date (any label; defaults to the bar index)

closes.description: Supply closes instead of fetching bars

weight.description: Portfolio weight (alternative to dollarValue; pair with totalValue)

name: portfolio_risk
